description: This file is a shell script for testing Git features related to commit-graph and partial clones, including setup, fetch operations, and validation steps.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified repository directory.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test expectation that should succeed, runs the provided commands.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks whether a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within a file.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file matches expected count.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
